title: Give Claude eyes to actually watch videos
description:
The transcript isn't why it went viral.

The frames are.

Same script, two different videos.

One flops, one hits a million.

The words were never the variable.

It was the first frame.

Cut timing. Text on screen.

Exactly when the b-roll lands.

Claude only reads transcripts right now.

So it studies the copyable layer.

The one everybody already has.

This skill rips the video into frames.

Then Claude breaks it down frame by frame.

Feed it a competitor's viral video.

Get the real reason it worked.

Runs locally, so no API bill.

Like reading the recipe.

Then wondering why theirs tastes better.

Everyone has the transcript.

Almost nobody looks at the frames.

Give Claude eyes and go look.

#claude #claudeskills #viralvideo #videoanalysis #ai
